#!/bin/sh
if test -f hello.txt; then
  KOGEN_LIFE_CHECK_INDEX='${control}/check-index'
  rm -f $KOGEN_LIFE_CHECK_INDEX
  GIT_INDEX_FILE=$KOGEN_LIFE_CHECK_INDEX git read-tree --empty || exit 1
  GIT_INDEX_FILE=$KOGEN_LIFE_CHECK_INDEX git add -A || exit 1
  GIT_INDEX_FILE=$KOGEN_LIFE_CHECK_INDEX git write-tree > '${control}/checked-tree' || exit 1
  cat hello.txt > '${control}/checked-hello'
  if test -f tip1.txt; then cat tip1.txt > '${control}/checked-tip1'; fi
fi
test -f hello.txt && test $(cat hello.txt) = hello
